name: Python 3 (Streamlit + FastAPI)
updateContentCommand: sudo apt update && sudo apt install -y tesseract-ocr tesseract-ocr-fra && python3 -m venv .venv && . .venv/bin/activate && pip install --upgrade pip && if [ -f requirements.txt ]; then pip install -r requirements.txt; else pip install streamlit; fi; echo '✅ Env ready'
